g.text: IR04 · CREATE REPOSITORY AND INITIAL ISSUES
g.title: With authorisation: repository setup, CI, documentation and durable issues
Jules or Codex/Agy; never both writing same branch
Small chunks; alternative Codex/Agy for broader changes
Alternative worker for deeper foundation or setup

g.text: IR08 · PUBLISH PR, VERIFY TESTS AND CI
g.title: Real code and evidence in GitHub, not agent prose
Chat manages review and corrections; human owns merge
Release is distinct from merge; explicit human decision
